en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a solitary stone observation tower standing on a small cleared hilltop, surrounded by tall trees. The tower has a rough‑hewn, blocky base, narrow vertical slit windows, and an upper section with a projecting rounded corner turret that rises slightly higher than the main structure and ends in crenellations with a flagpole on top. The scene is rural and there is no visible text or people.
